headline: NIPSCO AND EDP RENEWABLES ANNOUNCE LATEST INDIANA WIND FARM
summary:

(NYSE: NI), and EDP Renewables SA (EDPR), through its fully owned subsidiary EDP Renewables North America LLC (EDPR NA), have executed a Build & Transfer Agreement that will bring the 302 megawatt (MW) Indiana Crossroads Wind Farm to White County.
